info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Management Retrieval API enables users to access detailed account management information based on specific identifier parameters. This service primarily focuses on retrieving data related to product combinations associated with user accounts. Typical consumers include financial institutions, developers, and businesses requiring account data for reporting or integration purposes. By leveraging this API, clients can efficiently obtain account management insights tailored to their needs.

get.description: This endpoint allows the user to fetch detailed information about the specified product combination identified by its unique code. It provides essential attributes and current status, aiding in inventory management and product selection.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about the product combination identified by PROD-700045. It requires relevant parameters to be passed in the JSON format for a successful operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the requested product combination data is returned.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Request.description: A string that represents the request body for the specified GET operation related to product combinations.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Response_200.title: Account Management Product Combination Response

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer associated with the account.

ledgerDate.description: The date of the ledger entry.

currency.description: The currency used for the ledger balance.

ledgerBalance.description: The current balance in the ledger.

recordStatus.description: The status of the ledger record.

version.description: The version of the account entry.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the record.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Response_200.description: Response object for the account management product combination operation.
